data.one_liner: Custom TextInputFormatter implementations to enhance and standardize user input in Flutter forms.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of ready-to-use TextInputFormatters for Flutter text fields. It helps handle common text manipulation tasks such as capitalization, whitespace removal, emoji restriction, and character spacing.
use_when: You need to restrict input to exclude emojis or special characters.
You want to automatically format user input like capitalizing words or adding spaces at intervals.
You need to clean up whitespaces in form text fields.
avoid_when: You are not using Flutter's TextField or Form components.
You need advanced regex validation rather than input formatting.
strengths: Includes several out-of-the-box formatters for common use cases
Easy to integrate directly into existing Flutter TextFields
weaknesses: Limited to basic text formatting use cases provided in the kit
No documentation on complex input masking beyond provided formatters
